paragraphs: See the entry Abba Mar Marta.

notes.text: The supplied target is אבא מר מרתא, retained here as Abba Mar Marta. The William Davidson digital edition of Shabbat 121b reads אבא בר מרתא דהוא אבא בר מניומי, identifying Abba bar Marta with Abba bar Minyomi. This supports a possible מר/בר error in the pointer, but does not establish what Hyman’s printed page reads.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume I, printed p. 52, reads אבא בר מניומי ערך אבא מר מרתא, confirming מר in the supplied pointer. The next printed page heads the target אבא בר מרתא או מרת דהוא אבא בר מניומי: Abba bar Marta, or Marat, who is Abba bar Minyomi. Thus the pointer has מר while the target heading has בר. The English retains the pointer as written rather than silently correcting it. The Shabbat 121b comparison in the earlier note remains a separate digital witness; neither comparison imports the target notice’s biography or establishes an authority record. The earlier uncertainty about Hyman’s printed spelling predates this scan inspection.
